question: With which of the following classical dance forms is Deepika Reddy associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Deepika Reddy is an acclaimed Kuchipudi dancer.
 
• She started her journey 50 years ago and she had her Rangapravesham in 1976.
 
• She has performed across the world, including at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, Sri Lankan parliament, Hiroshima in Japan, and France.
 
• She received the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for her contribution to the Kuchipudi dance from President Ram Nath Kovind at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png]
